decisions.reason: The fifteen-day program draws on established production and logistics know-how and gives delivery results the firm can easily read, though consolidation into the broader express line D remains a real possibility.

The 72-hour program fits the firm's fast-response strategy and builds on existing spare-parts logistics, but it is operationally demanding and only mentioned on the website, so the risk of folding it into line D is elevated.

As the multi-model umbrella for fast delivery with its own page, it builds directly on core manufacturing and logistics competencies and absorbs what the firm learns from the narrower express programs.
The digital ordering platform supports trade partners and the service strategy, and its usage data is easy for the firm to assimilate and use to keep improving the offer.

Fire and smoke protection doors are a certified core competency backed by in-house engineering and R&D, and even after withdrawing Product C the firm has strong related knowledge to sustain this product.
